title: Arifureta Shokugyou de Sekai Saikyou Specials
justification: AniList 111729 has 2 episodes (2019-12-25 and 2020-02-26; synonyms 'Yue's Diary', 'Hot Love Springs Eternal'). AniDB 13624 S2 'Yue`s Diary' (12-25) and S3 'Hot Love Springs Eternal' / 'Naresome Onsen' (2020-02-26), consecutive. TVDB 357019 0x02 'Yue's Diary' (12-25) and 0x03 'The Hot Spring Where Romance Blooms' (02-26). S1 is the 2019-08-12 omnibus (0x01), S4 the Prologue; the Picture Drama S5-S17 are separate. The AniList synonyms carry both titles.
